folder_opened:
    type: labeled_counter
    description: >
      How many times folders of each type are opened.
    bugs:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1800775
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1899602
    data_reviews:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1800775#c3
    data_sensitivity:
      - technical
    notification_emails:
      - telemetry-client-dev@thunderbird.net
    expires: never
    labels:
      - Inbox
      - Drafts
      - Trash
      - SentMail
      - Templates
      - Junk
      - Archive
      - Queue
      - Virtual
      - Other

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: DBViewWrapper chooses the first matching known folder flag, including Virtual, and otherwise uses Other before adding one folderOpened count. Server roots return before this probe. The order resolves folders with more than one relevant flag. The labeled-counter registry declares the same public labels. A normal folder name is not a telemetry category. The browser test checks repeated opens and categories; no folder UI or telemetry submission was run here.
title: Choose folder telemetry labels from flags before the Other fallback
